g.text: Recovery, READY, SERVED and payment (4 of 4)
Expands PlayGame's beginTurn / submit / endTurn calls across turns 8-12.
Controller activation spans selected excerpts; UI entries/returns are omitted.
At turn-7 end C3 loses 8 -> 92. C2 pays, freeing T2. O3 is PREPARING 1/3.
[turns 8 and 9; Host WAIT, Waiter WAIT, Chef PREPARE O3]
Turn 9 beginTurn has remaining 0, so no recovery.
turn 10: Host seats C4 at T2; Waiter SERVE O3
Guard: READY and readyTurn 9 < current turn 10.
EATING / SERVED; no waiting loss. Satisfaction stays 84.
endTurn on turn 10 cannot finish eating: servedTurn == current turn.
turn 11 endTurn: finish one full eating turn
empty; C3 is not eligible until readyToPayTurn < turn
Tie-break: ready turn, arrival turn, arrival index.
Cumulative: 4194 cents, 3 paid. O3 and C3 are PAID; bill still 1944.
Eligibility checks and routine accessor calls are omitted.
Other customers use the same methods: C4 pays on 15 and C5 on 17.
PlayGame continues to endTurn on turn 18, integer result checks and VICTORY.
All-WAIT alternative ends DEFEAT. READY 9 -> SERVED 10 -> READY_TO_PAY 11 -> PAID 12.
